g.text: K-501 REFRIGERATION PACKAGE — PACKAGE SCOPE, INTERNALS HOLD
CAPACITY CONTROL IN THE PACKAGE HOLDS PI-501 AT 1.25 bar a
1. CAKES 110.7 t/h MELT AT 18 °C; MELT RETURN 110.6 t/h AT 91.2 wt% PX TO V-102.
2. REFRIGERATION LOAD 7.21 MW; STEAM 6.00 MW (MELTER + DRUM) AT THE DESIGN POINT.
3. K-501 PACKAGE SHOWN SIMPLIFIED (ONE PRESSURE LEVEL). ECONOMISERS, SURGE CONTROL AND RECEIVER LEVEL: HOLD.
4. SETTLE-OUT: C3= Psat AT 40 °C = 16.4 bar a; AT 45 °C ≈ 18.5 bar a. ALL C3= SIDE DESIGN PRESSURES ≥ 20 barg (HOLD, HAZOP R03).
5. PSV-401 SIZED FOR BOIL-OFF ON TV-403 FAILING OPEN (RELIEF TAB). DESTINATIONS: FLARE (TBC).
A. FIC-402 SP = RATIO × FI-101 × (0.7–1.3 FROM LIC-401), FY-402. A PURE LEVEL-TO-FLOW LOOP WOULD SWING THE RECYCLE.
B. TIC-403 → TV-403 (FO) HOLDS 18 °C. LSHH-405 (I-1) CLOSES XV-100 (SHT 1).
C. K-501 TRIP: SUCTION PRESSURE RISES, JACKETS WARM (STAGE 3 FIRST); CUT FEED BEFORE STAGE-1 CRYSTALS MELT OUT.
PX MELT CRYSTALLIZATION · OPERATOR TRAINING SIMULATOR
P&ID — PX MELT CRYSTALLIZATION · ALTERNATIVE VERSION (PX-MC-PID-001 SHEET 4 OF 4)
I-1: RESET IN THE SIS ONLY WHEN NO LSHH IS ACTIVE; XV-100 OPENS ON OPERATOR
COMMAND WHEN: PUMPS, SCRAPERS AND AGITATORS RUN; XV-118/218/318 OPEN; W-104,
C-204, C-304 RUN; TIC-403 IN AUTO AND P-402 RUNS; EVERY GROWTH VESSEL > 20 %.
I-2..I-4: XV-x18 RE-OPENS ONLY WHEN ITS CAUSE HAS CLEARED.
I-5: W-104 RESTART BY THE OPERATOR AFTER THE CAUSE CLEARS.
FAIL POSITIONS (INSTRUMENT AIR FAILURE, MODEL FAULT 18)
